title: CATEGORY IS... NOBLE LIE
about: On a gold-plated fight show judged by the State, a bruiser is beaten by a definition, a soul scanner sorts the losers into Bronze, and the Governor explains the Noble Lie as brutality dressed as a runway.

beats.text: Austin, in the Republic. A fighting cage plated in gold, a crowd at night, and a prize: the crown of Philosopher-King. Tonight's category is the Noble Lie.
Welcome back, my little constitutions. This is Texas. We don't do "truth." We do brand consistency.
The host is the Governor. Beside the masked judges stands the Soul Scanner, an arch of lights that reads what each contestant is made of.
see: a row of judges at a long table

beats.text: Patriots! Today's main challenge is inspired by the Myth of the Androgyne. Your task: create a Dual-Soul persona. Fifty percent UFC Bruiser. Fifty percent Pageant Queen. One hundred percent… state-approved.
Round one is a cage-match debate. The motion: Justice is Strength. The contestants must argue while they fight.
Wait. We gotta talk while we fight?
Yes, Bubba. That's called "democracy." Now don't overthink it.
First up: Bubba, a two-hundred-fifty-pound bruiser, against Madame Manifest Destiny, a strategist who reads Plato to win.
see: two boxers circling in a ring

beats.text: Justice is each part doing its job.
My job is… to win.
Define "win."
Uh— win is… when I—
—When you what?
When I make you stop!
So justice is… forcing others to stop?
Yes!
Then justice is coercion.
…No!
Contradiction detected.
Oh, Bubba… you just got eliminated by a definition.
Two more rounds follow: a runway in rhinestones and camouflage, and a lip sync to the Texas anthem. Then the bottom two face the boardroom.
see: models walking down a fashion runway

beats.text: Now. Before I fire someone on television— which, legally, is my love language— I have one question. What is your soul made of?
The scanner reads the first: fourteen percent gold, the rest panic. The second: two percent gold, the rest a desire for sandwiches.
see: a nervous woman on a stage

beats.text: Oh, sweetheart. You've got a Bronze soul… and quite frankly— your contour is patchy. SASHAY… YOU'RE FIRED.

beats.ask: it's a hard way to make a living

beats.text: The people think this is entertainment. The Regents think it's governance. I think it's both. That's the Noble Lie, baby. You make brutality look like a runway… and the runway feel like destiny.
